title: How to use ChatGPT's new, more natural Voice Mode for conversations - Engadget
summary: GPT-Live replaces the previous turn-based Advanced Voice model as the default option. Fortunately, you can revert to the older voice model by heading into ChatGPT's settings, navigating to Voice and selecting a different model.
